## About
Republic Icehouse sits across from UT Tyler on University Blvd. It's a casual, laid-back restaurant and bar, sort of like your place when a bunch of friends come over. Come for lunch or dinner, or just stop in for some drinks.
We've got a huge menu, so you'll find something you like. Behind the bar it's beer, wine and spirits, with a soft spot for Texas craft beers and Texas distilled spirits. We love the craft stuff, so there's a good chance you'll find something you've never tried.
Between games there's a pool table, shuffleboard, Golden Tee and MegaTouch. Folks around here give us 4.1 stars across 731 Google reviews.

## Services
- NFL Sunday Ticket: Every Sunday, the games are on.
- 12 Taps with quality Texas Brews: 12 taps pouring quality Texas brews, along with a good lineup of beer, wine and spirits.
- Texas Craft Beers and Texas Distilled Spirits: A wide selection from right here in Texas. Ask what's new.
- Daily Drink and Lunch Specials: Something different on special every day.
- Happy Hour: Monday-Friday: 4 p.m. - 6:30 p.m.
- Pizza to Go: Take a pizza home with you.

## FAQ
Q: How late are you open on Saturday?
A: Saturday we're open 11:00 AM – 1:00 AM.

Q: Is there a dress code?
A: We're a casual place, but you're in public, so dress accordingly.

Q: Can I smoke?
A: Only outside, in the designated smoking areas.

## What customers say
- "Icehouse is always one of my favorite places to go. It does not matter if I am in a larger group or with just one other person the service is great. I enjoy the restaurant side just as much as I enjoy sitting at the bar. I have not yet ordered a single thing on the menu that was not amazing. Great atmosphere. Great service. Great food." (Kimberly Burks, 5/5)
- "Another place marked off the list!!!  Today I had lunch with my wife and 2 of my boys at the Republic Icehouse. I’m not sure why I’ve never ate here before, but I’m sure glad I stopped in today.

Aside from the cesar salad (lettuce was slightly wilted in places and browning) everything else we ordered was really good.

I ordered the stuffed bacon wrapped jalapeños as an appetizer. They came out nice and hot. We all enjoyed those, seeing as they were gone 5 minutes after they were set on the table. They weren’t spicy at all for all my fellow wimps reading this.

I got the parmesan chicken sandwich with fries. The chicken was tender and lightly breaded. It had a good amount of mozzarella and the marinara wasn’t too much at all. The sourdough bun was nicely toasted as well. I really enjoyed the fries and so did everyone else. They reminded me of a skinnier version of Jucy’s fries.

One of my boys ordered a regular chicken sandwich, which happened to be absolutely massive and the other ordered a patty melt. Both of them really liked their food and had no complaints.

My wife got the steak fingers. I even got to try them myself and I honestly thought they were great. They weren’t overly chewy by any means and the batter was just right. The gravy was also on point.

THEY HAVE GOOD RANCH!!! In case anyone was wondering.

Great service combined with a college like atmosphere made for a good overall dining experience for my family and I.

I can definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for some good food. I know I’d like to try the pizza and the burger next time." (Nicholas Ballew (Big Back Ballew), 4/5)
- "Coming early on a Wednesday isn't the best if you're looking for a party atmosphere, but it is calmer in here. Made to order food takes a bit, but everything is delicious. Blue cheese dressing is a bit thin though." (JustMe, 4/5)
